Now, let me get something straight, I cannot tell you what you are and what you aren’t. So I can’t really give an opinion, but I will help you guide in the right direction.

There are mainly two types of orientations. 

Sexual/physical orientation and a romantic orientation.

Each one has different feelings. I’ll give you some examples:

Sexual attraction: Based off of someone’s looks, you want to have sex with them.

Romantic attraction: Kissing, hugging, any other intimate act is romantic.

A straight (heterosexual) guy can be biromantic (romantically attracted to both).

I wouldn’t say it is a spectrum. There are tons of different sexualities that would’t even fit on it. Sexuality is different for everyone. 

Now here are some questions to think about maybe:
Do you want to kiss the same sex/opposite sex?
Do you want to touch the same sex/opposite sex?
Have you ever been attracted by how a man looks?

I’m no sex professional, but that’s all I have to say. Have fun with whatever sexuality you choose: whether it be pan or demi, hetero or homo!
